programme.title: Happy Kids
programme.desc: Happy Kid, a young boy, along with his three close friends, Luay, Lamy and Zaim, experiences various fun-filled adventures.

programme.title: Subha Muhurtham
programme.desc: Rajamannar, a marriage broker, is a free and an easy-going man. However, for his daughter's marriage, he puts his skills and experience to the test in order to lure a wealthy suitor.

programme.title: Sumai
programme.desc: Sathyan, a middle-class man, works hard and saves every penny to financially support his large family. However, his father always gets into trouble by stealing money or gambling with his friends.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

programme.title: Bheeshma
programme.desc: When Bheeshma gets involved with Chaitra, an employee of Bheeshma Organics, he develops an interest in organic farming. Trouble ensues when her company announces a new product that seems to be shady.

programme.title: Azhagesan
programme.desc: Azhagesan, a man with a mental disability, secretly loves his cousin Nandini. However, when Sekhar, an evil man, rapes Nandini and beats Azhagesan, she ends up killing Sekhar and goes to prison.

programme.title: Sri Raja Rajeswari
programme.desc: Raja and Rajeshwari are killed by Ravindranath and his gang. Before dying, Rajeshwari vows that she will return for revenge and with the blessings of a goddess, she is reborn to keep her promise.

programme.title: Maraivaasi
programme.desc: A billionaire's son returns after his father's death and joins the company as a regular employee in order to nab the people responsible for his father's murder.

programme.title: Azhagu Raja
programme.desc: Azhagu Raja, who owns a cable channel, always mocks Priya, who fails at everything. Eventually, love blossoms between them, but their families' bitter past becomes an obstacle to their marriage.

programme.title: Vasanthakala Paravai
programme.desc: Ravi, a shopkeeper, falls in love with Uma, a student, who belongs to a rich family. But their relationship is tested when Uma's brother decides to intervene and break their bond.

programme.title: Thaali Dhaanam
programme.desc: Sridhar marries Kalyani, a kind-hearted woman, and the two live in marital bliss for 12 years. However, their lives take a turn when Kalyani is unable to conceive, leaving her heartbroken.

programme.title: Thayi Pongal
programme.desc: Janaki loses her husband early in her life and is left with a girl child. Without any support, she experiences tough situations involving lecherous men. She meets Vairam who supports her.

programme.title: Fillers
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

programme.title: Deiva Vaakku
programme.desc: Hamsaveni's divine power earns her respect among the villagers, whereas her brother, Vallatharai, tries to exploit her power for his personal gain. He goes to the extent of sabotaging her marriage.

programme.title: Vaada
programme.desc: Vetrivel decides to exact revenge on the man who destroyed his life. Soon, his wife, an ardent MGR fan, encourages her husband to be inspired from the reel-life hero.

programme.title: Samundi
programme.desc: Samundi and his mother move into a nearby hamlet to live peacefully. However, terror strikes them once again through the local goon, who spoiled his sister's life.

programme.title: Kalki
programme.desc: Chellammaa, a professional singer, ties the knot with a businessman. However, their marriage takes a bitter turn when he discovers that she cannot bear children.

programme.title: Kidaari
